verdict.rationale: The Comptroller's own file-and-pay page states up front that you must register and log into eSystems to reach Webfile, and the probe confirms the Webfile surface sits behind an authenticated eSystems session. That one account prerequisite is disclosed before you start. Nothing documents which credentials (WebFile number, taxpayer number, access codes) or identity-proofing steps registration involves. Missing for 10: a published enumeration of the credentials needed to register, any disclosure of identity-proofing steps, and a stated end-to-end prerequisite checklist before filing.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Once you register and log into eSystems, you can access Webfile.
the Webfile transaction surface exists only behind an authenticated eSystems session
